:::{#exm-entropy-degenerate}
#### Entropy of a random variable that is not random

Let $X$ be a [discrete random variable](random-variables.qmd#def-discrete-rv) that takes one value $x_0$ with [probability](probability-basics.qmd#def-probability) $1$.
By @thm-entropy-discrete, the [entropy](#def-entropy) of $X$ is

$$\entropyf{X} = -1 \cdot \log 1 = 0.$$

This is the smallest value @thm-entropy-discrete-nonnegative allows,
and the fair coin in @exm-entropy-coin has a larger entropy.

<!-- no-figure: a single closed-form value -->

:::
